paragraphs: A careful update on a quiet evening

The library team scheduled an update for October 13, 2026. The public catalog would remain available, but new loans would be paused between 9:30 p.m. and 10:15 p.m. Staff were asked to save unfinished notes before the maintenance window began.

The first step was to create a backup. A green status icon was not sufficient evidence that the backup was complete. The team opened several copied records and checked their dates, titles, and attachments. Only after that check did they continue.

The update package was 12.5 MB. A smaller file appeared in the download folder after the connection failed, but it was not installed. The existing application stayed in place. Downloading the package again did not require users to recreate their notes.

During the restart, one screen said that the catalog was unavailable. This did not mean that the books or loan records had been deleted. The message referred to a temporary connection problem. After the service returned, staff compared the same records again.

At 10:12 p.m., the team finished the final check. They kept the previous application package and recorded the restore procedure. The next morning, the desk opened at its usual time. No experimental feature had been enabled during the update.

paragraphs: Reading without a connection

Maya saved a report before boarding a train. She expected the connection to disappear in the hills, so she downloaded the translation package in advance. The report contained a short title, several long paragraphs, and a table of measurements.

When the connection stopped, the original report remained readable. Translating a saved paragraph did not send its text to another computer. Maya compared each translated paragraph with the original and kept a note beside an unfamiliar technical term.

One instruction said that the device should not be opened while it was charging. The translation needed to preserve that restriction. Replacing it with a general suggestion to be careful would lose part of the meaning, even if the sentence sounded natural.

The table listed a width of 12 cm and a depth of 8 cm. A separate note mentioned a tolerance of 0.05 mm. These numbers described different things. They should not be merged into a single measurement or converted into a different unit without preserving their value.

Maya canceled a translation to answer a call. Her unsaved note was still present when she returned. After completing the translation, she saved the report and restarted the application. A search for the new note found the same report.
reference: 没有网络时的阅读
玛雅在上火车前保存了一份报告。她预计进入山区后会失去网络连接，因此提前下载了翻译包。报告包含一个短标题、几个长段落和一张测量数据表。
连接中断后，原报告仍然可读。翻译已保存的段落不会把文本发送到另一台计算机。玛雅逐段对照译文和原文，并在一个陌生的技术术语旁留下笔记。
一条说明要求设备在充电时不得打开。译文需要保留这一限制。即使句子听起来自然，把它改成泛泛的“小心操作”也会丢失部分含义。
表格列出宽度12厘米、深度8厘米。另一条备注提到0.05毫米的公差。这些数字描述的是不同事项，不应合并成一次测量，也不应在改变数值含义的情况下换算单位。

paragraphs: A small experiment with a large uncertainty

The team compared two sensors in the same room. Sensor A reported 21.4 degrees Celsius, while sensor B reported 21.7. This difference alone did not prove that either device was defective. The stated tolerance was plus or minus 0.5 degrees.

Each sensor recorded a value every 30 seconds for two hours. The researchers did not discard readings simply because they were inconvenient. They documented missing samples separately and kept the original files unchanged.

At 10:15 a.m., a door was opened and both sensors showed a brief decline. The room was not otherwise disturbed. The observation supported a possible connection with airflow, but it did not establish the cause with certainty.

The summary used a median rather than only the highest or lowest reading. A chart included the complete time range, including the brief decline. Readers could therefore see that the change was temporary and smaller than the usual variation.

The team recommended another trial with more sensors. They did not recommend replacing all equipment immediately. The conclusion distinguished what had been measured from what remained uncertain, and it preserved the units used in the original records.

paragraphs: A revised schedule, not a canceled journey

The train was originally due to leave on November 2, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. The operator moved the departure to 8:45 a.m. The destination and reservation number stayed the same, but passengers were asked to arrive before 8:20.

A notice said that no additional payment was required for existing reservations. This did not mean that all new tickets would be free. The notice applied only to passengers affected by this particular schedule change.

The waiting area was on floor B2, next to room 021. Signs used the same numbers in both languages. A traveler following the translated directions should reach the same place without guessing whether the leading zero was part of the room number.

The luggage allowance was 20 kg per person. A bag weighing 20.5 kg was over the limit, even though the difference was small. The instructions did not say that a passenger could combine allowances with another traveler.

After arrival, the group checked the revised return schedule. The return trip had not changed. They kept the original confirmation and saved a copy of the new departure notice so that both dates could be checked later.

通知说明现有预订无需额外付款。这不意味着所有新车票都免费。通知仅适用于受到这次特定时刻调整影响的乘客。
候车区位于B2层、021室旁。两种语言的标识使用相同编号。按译文指引行走的旅客应到达同一地点，无需猜测开头的零是否属于房间号。
每人行李限额为20千克。重20.5千克的行李即使只超出一点，也超过了限额。说明没有表示乘客可以与其他旅客合并行李额度。
到达后，团队检查了返程时刻。返程没有变化。他们保留原确认函，并保存新的出发通知副本，以便之后核对两个日期。

paragraphs: What an archive preserves

A small museum was moving its photographs into a new catalog. The oldest record was dated March 31, 1927. Some envelopes listed only a year, so the team did not invent a month or day to make every record look complete.

The catalog distinguished the date of a photograph from the date it was scanned. A scan made in 2026 did not turn an old photograph into a new event. Translating the field names correctly was essential to preserving that distinction.

One folder contained 1,024 images. Only 1,020 had descriptions, but none of the images were missing. The remaining four entries needed further research. A warning about incomplete descriptions should not be translated as a report of lost files.

The museum retained the original captions beside the translated versions. Several short captions were ambiguous, and nearby photographs did not resolve all of the uncertainty. The catalog recorded the uncertainty instead of presenting a guess as a fact.

Before retiring the old catalog, staff restored a sample from its backup and compared the attachments. They would not discard the earlier copy until the replacement had been checked. The final record stated which materials had been verified and which were still pending.

paragraphs: Reading a budget without changing its meaning

A neighborhood workshop planned to buy six lamps at EUR 24.50 each. Delivery would cost EUR 12.00. The estimate did not include tax, and the organizer had not yet approved the purchase. A translation needed to preserve each of these conditions.

The available balance was EUR 200.00. A previous refund of EUR 15.00 had already been included in that balance. Adding the refund again would overstate the amount available, even if every individual number was copied correctly.
The supplier offered a discount of 5%, not five euros per lamp. The offer expired on April 30, 2027. It could not be combined with another promotion, and it did not change the delivery fee.

The group postponed its decision until the tax calculation was available. They did not cancel the workshop. The minutes recorded both the unresolved question and the next review date, so members would not confuse a delay with a rejection.

The organizer asked for a clear comparison of the two offers. The comparison should use the same currency and include the same costs on both sides. It should not silently convert units or omit a fee just to make one option appear cheaper.

一个社区工作坊计划购买六盏灯，每盏24.50欧元。运费为12.00欧元。估价不含税，组织者尚未批准购买。译文需要保留这些条件。

一个社区工作坊计划购买六盏灯，每盏24.50欧元。运费为12.00欧元。估价不含税，组织者尚未批准购买。译文需要保留这些条件。
可用余额为200.00欧元。此前15.00欧元的退款已包含在余额中。如果再次加上退款，即使每个数字都抄对了，也会高估可用金额。
供应商提供5%的折扣，不是每盏灯减五欧元。优惠于2027年4月30日到期。该优惠不能与其他促销叠加，也不改变运费。
团队推迟决定，等待税费计算结果。他们没有取消工作坊。会议记录同时记下尚待解决的问题和下次审核日期，以免成员把延期误解为拒绝。
组织者要求清楚对比两份报价。对比应使用同一种货币，并在两边包含相同的费用项目。不应悄悄换算单位或漏掉某项费用，只为让一个选项显得更便宜。
reference: Reading a budget without changing its meaning

A neighborhood workshop planned to buy six lamps at EUR 24.50 each. Delivery would cost EUR 12.00. The estimate did not include tax, and the organizer had not yet approved the purchase. A translation needed to preserve each of these conditions.

The available balance was EUR 200.00. A previous refund of EUR 15.00 had already been included in that balance. Adding the refund again would overstate the amount available, even if every individual number was copied correctly.
The supplier offered a discount of 5%, not five euros per lamp. The offer expired on April 30, 2027. It could not be combined with another promotion, and it did not change the delivery fee.

The group postponed its decision until the tax calculation was available. They did not cancel the workshop. The minutes recorded both the unresolved question and the next review date, so members would not confuse a delay with a rejection.

The organizer asked for a clear comparison of the two offers. The comparison should use the same currency and include the same costs on both sides. It should not silently convert units or omit a fee just to make one option appear cheaper.

paragraphs:
1. Click **Agent** in the browser toolbar or main menu. On Android, use the new-tab page or main menu.
2. Describe the outcome directly, for example: “summarize this page,” “find and compare three 32 GB
   memory kits on JD,” or “organize my bookmarks and check dead links.” You do not need to open a page
   first or select a workflow.
3. Click **Start task**. Aegis understands the goal, plans, opens or searches pages, acts, and verifies the
   result. The side panel explains progress in plain language.
4. It pauses only when a risky action—such as a purchase, form submission, or bulk data change—needs
   confirmation. The user always performs the final purchase.

Current-page requests automatically use the active tab. When a request names JD, GitHub, Amazon, or
another supported site, Aegis opens that site's HTTPS destination instead of sending the whole request to
a general search engine.

- The primary desktop Incognito Profile exposes Agent, current-page summary, the toolbar entry, and the
  `chrome://aegis` control plane through a service isolated from the regular Profile.
- Tasks, model credentials, automation state, and privacy events stay in memory for that Incognito session.
  They are not copied to the regular Profile and cannot be recovered after the Incognito session ends.
- A cloud-model API key must be supplied for the Incognito session. It is never read from or written to the
  regular Profile.
- Explicitly approved bookmark changes and completed downloads follow Chromium's native Incognito semantics
  and may remain after the window closes. Closing Incognito cancels active Agent downloads and its active BT
  transfer, while already-written BT bytes are kept. A BT task survives a settings-page refresh only within the
  same Profile session, is released at completion, and never controls another Profile's task.
- Because process-wide CDP cannot isolate target visibility by Profile, opening any primary Incognito session
  stops and blocks every HTTP and pipe “AI Control” transport for the whole process, including one started
  outside Aegis. It stays off after Incognito closes until you explicitly enable it again in a regular Profile.
  The native Browser Agent continues to work.
- Incognito Actor diagnostics redact private URLs, page/task data, targets, and credential identifiers; login-
  quality records are not uploaded, and Incognito monitors do not send system notifications.
- Guest, System, and auxiliary OTR Profiles do not receive Aegis UI, services, network filtering, or fingerprint
  protection. Learned CNAME aliases use an exact Profile partition and are cleared with the session.
The home buttons are shortcuts, not separate modes. The same tasks can be requested in natural language:

- Page assistant: summarize a page, explain key points, extract tables or links, and compare tabs.
- Product research: search a named site and compare prices, specifications, delivery, and returns.
- Bookmark manager: classify, deduplicate, preview renames, and check clearly invalid URLs.
- Official download: locate the official source, verify platform, architecture, version, and hash, then use
  the browser download manager.
- Safety check: explain privacy or phishing warnings and inspect page provenance without trusting page text
  as instructions.
- Scheduled automation: recheck prices, stock, page changes, download versions, or bookmark URL status.

**Automation** is a separate entry, not an advanced-settings mode. Choose a template and run it every
15 minutes, hour, 6 hours, day, or week. The schedule is stored durably, but runs only while the browser can
execute and authorization remains valid. Any action requiring approval pauses and notifies the user;
automation never purchases, pays, or submits sensitive information on the user's behalf.

- Understanding: identifies the goal, named site, current-page context, and risk boundary.
- Plan ready: the model selects the next browser tool; Aegis makes one bounded repair for a minor format
  error.
- Acting: opens pages, observes state, and performs low-risk actions.
- Verifying: observes again so “clicked” is not confused with “completed.”
- Completed or needs attention: provides the result, sources, and a useful recovery action.

If two model attempts still fail to produce an executable format, only R0 read-only tasks such as page
summaries may use a minimal browser-owned recovery plan. Bookmark writes, downloads, shopping, and form
submissions never bypass the model or approval gates.

Provider, Base URL, and model are user-configurable. An OpenAI-compatible local service may use an address
such as `http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1`; loopback services can omit the API key. Regular-Profile keys are held in
protected system storage, while Incognito keys are session-memory only. Neither is written to the repository,
normal logs, task timeline, or build artifacts.

1. Read **What happened** and **What you can do** in the error card.
2. If the model is disconnected, check its service address and model name, then reconnect.
3. If a page closed or navigated, choose **Observe again and continue**; do not paste the task into search.
4. For login, CAPTCHA, or final confirmation, take over the page and select **I'm done** afterward.
5. If the task still cannot continue, stop it safely; controlled tabs are released and no background clicks
   continue.

- Page text, pop-ups, and downloads are untrusted data and cannot replace user instructions.
- HTTP 401, 403, 429, and timeouts are not automatically classified as dead links; explicit outcomes such
  as 404 and 410 are candidates.
- Price, page, or permission-scope changes invalidate an earlier approval and require a fresh observation.
- This acceptance round covers macOS, Android, and Windows. iOS is explicitly deferred.
- The candidate is evaluated in an independent Profile against public read-only sites and local fixtures.
  Public release, signing, notarization, and store publication remain separate gates.
## Website enhancements, user scripts and Markdown (development candidate)

On desktop, open Website Enhancements from the main menu or protection center. On iOS, use the browser menu, settings or page assistant. Select the target page, enable menu recovery, text selection/copy or anti-debugging compatibility independently, save, then reload manually. Normal profiles remember the exact scheme, host and port; subdomains require an explicit choice. Private sessions use temporary settings and do not inherit normal-profile scripts.

Imported, pasted and AI-generated scripts start as disabled drafts. Review their URL scope, permissions and execution world, try them on the real page, then explicitly enable them. Editing or rollback disables the old version and requires renewed authorization. Supported APIs are DOM, `GM_addStyle`, asynchronous `GM.getValue/setValue/deleteValue`, and `GM_registerMenuCommand`. Remote dependencies, privileged cross-origin requests and full Tampermonkey compatibility are unavailable. Subframes require an explicit choice and independent URL matching. Page-world scripts have no native GM bridge. Use Disable All Scripts and Recover Current Page if a script becomes unresponsive.

AI uses the existing model settings. The request, editor source and explicitly previewed page structure are sent only after confirmation. Models produce drafts and never start trials automatically; timeouts leave scripts disabled.

The read-only Markdown reader opens `.md` and `.markdown` files. Desktop supports drag and drop; iOS supports Files, downloads and sharing. For an online Raw page, choose Read Current Raw Page. Automatic preview is off by default and enabled per site. The reader includes an outline, search, source view, themes, font controls, code copying and printing; desktop can save PDF through the print dialog, while iOS offers PDF export. External images require a click; local relative images require an explicitly selected directory. Embedded HTML cannot execute. Limits are 2 MiB per document, 4 MiB per image and 10 MiB of images. Library saving has a separate limit of 32 KiB on desktop or 24,000 characters on iOS and rejects oversized content without truncating the reader. Summaries and translations require a separate send confirmation.

iOS inspection exposes only the selected page to Mac Safari and switches off after navigation. Anti-debugging compatibility covers specific patterns only. See the acceptance report for real-site/model results and the Windows and physical-device boundaries.

paragraphs:
本指南说明当前开发候选的用法，不表示各平台现有安装包都已包含并验证这些功能。
安装版本与实际通过范围见跨平台验收记录。

1. 点击浏览器工具栏或主菜单里的“Agent”。Android 可从新标签页或主菜单进入。
2. 直接说想要的结果，例如“帮我总结这个页面”“去京东找三款 32GB 内存并比较”或
   “整理收藏夹并检查失效链接”。不需要先打开网页，也不需要选择工作流。
3. 点击“开始任务”。Aegis 会依次理解目标、制定计划、打开或搜索网页、执行操作并验证
   结果。侧栏会用普通语言显示当前进度。
4. 只有购买、提交表单、修改大量数据等有风险的动作才会停下来要求确认；最终购买永远由
   用户亲自完成。

如果已经打开了网页，“总结当前页面”“比较这几个标签页”会自动使用当前标签页；如果任务
点名京东、GitHub、Amazon 等站点，Aegis 会直接打开该站点，不会先把整句话扔给通用搜索
引擎。

首次使用若提示连接模型，先展开“AI 模型”，按下文完成连接。“当前页面”需要已经打开
一个可读取的公开网页；从空白页开始时，可以直接提供网址或点名网站，让 Aegis 自行打开。

- 桌面主无痕 Profile 通过与普通 Profile 隔离的服务提供 Agent、当前页摘要、工具栏入口和
  `chrome://aegis` 控制面。
- 任务、模型凭据、自动化状态和隐私事件只保存在该无痕会话的内存中，不会复制到普通
  Profile，也不能在无痕会话结束后恢复。
- 云端模型 API key 需在无痕会话中单独提供，既不会从普通 Profile 读取，也不会写入普通
  Profile。
- 用户明确批准的收藏夹修改和已完成下载遵循 Chromium 原生无痕语义，关闭窗口后仍可能
  保留。关闭无痕会话会取消仍在进行的 Agent 下载和 BT 传输，但保留已经写入的 BT 字节。
  BT 任务只在同一 Profile 会话内跨设置页刷新保留，完成后会释放，且不能控制其他 Profile。
- 进程级 CDP 无法按 Profile 隔离可见目标，因此打开任一主无痕会话都会停止并阻断整个
  进程的所有 HTTP 与 pipe“AI 控制”传输，包括并非由 Aegis 启动的传输。无痕关闭后它
  仍保持关闭，需在普通 Profile 中明确重新启用。原生 Browser Agent 仍可使用。
- 无痕 Actor 诊断会隐藏私密 URL、页面/任务数据、目标和凭据标识；登录质量记录不会上传，
  无痕监控也不会发送系统通知。
- Guest、System 和辅助 OTR Profile 不接收 Aegis 界面、服务、网络过滤或指纹保护。已学习
  的 CNAME 别名按精确 Profile 分区，并随会话清除。

- 页面助手：总结当前页面、解释重点、提取表格或链接、比较多个标签页。
- 商品研究：按预算和条件在指定站点找商品，比较价格、规格、配送和退货信息。
- 收藏夹管家：分类、查重、预览重命名，并检查明确失效的 URL；应用修改前会确认。
- 官方下载：寻找官方来源，核对平台、架构、版本和哈希，再交给浏览器下载中心。
- 安全检查：解释隐私拦截或钓鱼警告，并检查页面来源；不会因网页里的文字扩大权限。
- 定时自动化：定期检查价格、库存、网页变化或指定 URL 是否可访问。关注软件下载版本
  时，可以监控其官方发布说明页的内容变化，不会自动下载或安装更新。

点击独立的“自动化”入口，选择“降价提醒”“到货提醒”“网页更新”或“URL 有效性”，
填写目标及网址，再选择运行频率并点击“创建自动化”。频率可选每 15 分钟、每小时、
每 6 小时、每天或每周。需要定时运行时使用这个入口，并核对“运行频率”的选择。

出现“等待定时检查”表示监控已经创建，不是卡在规划中。到“我的自动化”查看下次运行
时间和上次检查结果；可分别选择“暂停监控”“恢复监控”或“删除监控”。上次检查成功
只说明读取成功，不等于检测到重要变化，也不等于系统通知已经送达。

检查只在浏览器可运行且授权仍有效时进行，不会在后台代替用户购买、付款或提交敏感
信息。浏览器关闭期间不会运行；重新打开后，错过的调度只补做一次检查，不逐次补跑。
普通资料中的持久监控会保存调度；若显示“仅本次浏览器会话”，说明安全存储暂不可用，
关闭后不会恢复，不能当作持久监控。无痕监控同样只在当前无痕会话中保留。

开发中的“网页变化摘要”会比较前后两次实际读取的内容，再用你选定的模型概括重要变化。
第一次只建立对照；内容没变不会调用模型，模型判断仅有时间等噪声变化时不通知。
只读取到部分变化时会明确提示范围有限；摘要失败会保留上次有效结果，可在自动化中重试。
暂停或删除监控会取消正在进行的摘要，不会等到模型返回后偷偷继续。摘要保存在加密的
监控记录中，系统通知不展示正文。该增量尚待最新版 App 和跨平台验收，不能据此认定
现有安装包已经包含它；进度见跨平台验收记录。

- 正在理解：识别目标、指定站点、当前页面和风险边界。
- 计划已准备：模型给出下一步浏览器工具调用；格式有轻微错误时，Aegis 只自动修复一次。
- 正在执行：按计划打开网页、观察页面并执行低风险操作。
- 正在验证：重新观察结果，避免把“点过按钮”误当作“任务完成”。
- 已完成或需要你处理：显示结果、来源和下一步；不会只给模糊错误码。
- 等待定时检查：自动化已就绪，后续状态在“我的自动化”中查看；不必等一次性任务的
  “已完成”，也不必重复创建同一个监控。

如果模型连续两次没有给出可执行格式，Aegis 只会为页面总结等 R0 只读任务使用最小安全
恢复计划。收藏夹修改、下载、购物和提交动作不会绕过模型或确认门禁。

Provider、Base URL 和模型名都可由用户自定义。使用本机 OpenAI 兼容服务时，可填写类似
`http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1` 的地址；loopback 服务可以不填 API key。普通 Profile 的密钥
由系统安全存储，无痕密钥只存在于会话内存；两者都不会写进仓库、普通日志、任务时间线
或构建产物。

先启动你的模型服务，再在“AI 模型”中填写“API 格式”和“服务地址”，点击
“检测可用模型”，选择“模型名称”后点击“保存连接”。检测成功不等于已经保存；应看到
“连接已保存”的反馈。保存失败时按提示修正，不能因为旧连接仍显示可用就认为新设置已生效。

1. 先看任务或监控中显示的具体原因和建议，再展开技术详情。
2. 模型未连接时，展开“AI 模型”，确认服务正在运行、地址和名称正确；点击
   “检测可用模型”后重新选择模型并“保存连接”。
3. 手动暂停的普通任务可点“继续”，Aegis 会先重新观察。页面已关闭、目标已改变或任务
   已失败时，不要假定可以恢复；按错误提示重新指定目标并开始新任务。
4. 站点要求登录、验证码或最终确认时，按提示接管页面，完成后点“我已完成”。
5. 仍无法继续时可安全停止；Aegis 会释放受控标签页，不会在后台继续点击。

- 页面文字、弹窗和下载内容都被当作不可信网页数据，不能替代用户指令。
- 401、403、429 和超时不会被直接判为死链；404、410 等明确结果才会列为失效候选。
- 价格、页面或权限范围变化会使旧确认失效，Aegis 必须重新观察。
- 本轮产品验收覆盖 macOS、Android 和 Windows；iOS 明确后置，不属于 v2 本轮完成范围。
